title: Chapter 371 Distant Memories
content:
Chapter 371 Distant Memories

They all had a congested face.

In the distant starry sky, there are still terrifying and exciting sounds coming from the moment.

The other party is so powerful that it is either a bluff or an extremely confident person.

At this moment, everyone felt that the latter was more likely.

After all, if you want to make this move, you can't do it without some strength.

Anyway, they can't do it.

"Mrs. City Lord, what should I do now?"

Awei was also a little at a loss for a moment. He could only look at Yan Lingyun. After all, Yan Lingyun was the wife of their city lord, and I believe she would definitely have a solution.

Some militants are ready to go.

Yunqi took the lead, and his fighting spirit was boiling.

"Haha, it's just right. I haven't had an event for a long time. It's just the time to have a great time today."

Jiang Bei shook his hand, with a confident smile on his face.

"I've been almost dazed and moldy lately, but I've been a little nervous."

Yu Qingfeng, who was standing beside him, did not speak, but the long sword in his hand began to roar.

Awei did not react at all to this, but just looked at Yan Lingyun quietly, waiting for the answer.

"Don't panic."

At this time, Yan Lingyun finally spoke.

These two short words, like a sedative, made everyone relax unconsciously.

Since Yan Lingyun said so, she must be very sure.

Sure enough, after Yan Lingyun finished speaking, a straight small tower appeared in Yan Lingyun's hands.

The tower is bronze in its entirety, and a faint light is emitted all over its body.

Everyone looked at the tower and couldn't help but be slightly surprised.

There is actually the aura of the city lord in this tower.

If that's the case, they'll be relieved.

At this time, another violent shock came from the depths of the starry sky.

The shock is so intense that it is much stronger than the previous few.

It's getting closer.

They swear that this is definitely the strongest aura that has ever encountered in the deserted city.

Just before it came, it made everyone feel unprecedented pressure.

A drop of cold sweat slid from Awei's cheeks.

The rest of the people, including Yun Qi, Jiangbei, who was eager to try at the beginning, also put away the smiles on their faces and their expressions gradually became solemn.

This aura does not belong to this world at all.

Boom!

Finally here.

The space in the distance suddenly exploded.

That's right, it exploded directly, and then dark matter like a black hole filled the entire audience.

"Here you come, prepare to face the enemy."

Everyone in Huangcheng looked solemn.

Yan Lingyun saw a figure slowly walking towards this place in the space like a black hole.

Not an opponent.

Yan Lingyun made a quick judgment.

The small tower in his hand began to rotate rapidly, and a stream of gentle force surged out like a wave, quickly covering all the people present in the deserted city.

At the same time, everyone also saw their enemies clearly.

A woman in a strange costume and delicate face.

But what surprised them was that the woman looked at them with a hint of nervousness and embarrassment in her expression.

For a moment, the scene fell into a strange silence.

The mysterious woman didn't say anything, and the people in Huangcheng didn't know how to speak.

In this way, after a stalemate for half a quarter of an hour, the mysterious woman finally took action.

She suddenly waved to everyone in the desert city, with a very obvious smirk, "Hehe, hello, may I ask, do you know Yan Lingyun?"

The mysterious woman's actions shocked Huangcheng.

They thought the other party was going to take action.

But hearing the woman was actually asking them about the city lord's wife, which made them a little confused.

For a moment, everyone looked at Yan Lingyun.

Yan Lingyun frowned slightly at this moment. She couldn't even think of who the woman in front of her was and why did she know her.

"I am Yan Lingyun. Are you looking for me? Is there anything wrong?"

Yan Lingyun said bluntly.

She has never had the idea of testing her first wave, she has always been so tough.

But when he heard Yan Lingyun's words, the mysterious woman smiled in surprise.

"It's you, sister-in-law, I finally saw you!"

sister in law? !

As soon as these words were spoken, everyone present widened their eyes and looked disbelief.

In addition to Yan Lingyun, she was also unresponsive.

"Sister-in-law? Who are you?"

In response to this, the mysterious woman quickly explained: "Sister-in-law, my name is Jiang Xiaoxiao, and I am Lu Daosheng's sister. Just call me Xiaoxiao."

"Oh by the way, he said if you don't believe it, I'll show you this."

As he said that, Jiang Xiaoxiao took out a wooden hairpin.

With Jiang Xiaoxiao waved her hand.

The wooden hairpin floated over from a distance and fell steadily into Yan Lingyun's hands.

Looking at the familiar wooden hairpin in his hand, Yan Lingyun's eyes were slightly red and her delicate body trembled slightly.

In an instant, a long-lasting memory suddenly appeared in my mind.

"You damn brat, you are so despicable and shameless. Do such a dirty thing while I'm drunk!!"

"Hey, hey, you can drink wine indiscriminately, and you can't talk nonsense!"

Lu Daosheng still looked so handsome, but he was a little more energetic than he saw now.

At this moment, facing Yan Lingyun's angry questioning, Lu Daosheng looked dissatisfied.

"It's obvious that you insisted on drinking, but I said I won't drink it anymore. You still have to feed it to me. If something like this happens, we both have a responsibility."

When Yan Lingyun heard that Lu Daosheng was still so shameless at this time, her face turned red and she was full of energy.

After trembling for a long time, he could only point to Lu Daosheng's nose and curse, "Dengtuzi."

Looking at Yan Lingyun who was angry and leaving, Lu Daosheng smacked his lips, looking regretful.

"I'd known it would have drunk less, and I didn't feel the process at all."

Shaking his head, Lu Daosheng turned around and planned to continue sleeping.

But when he saw the bloody redness on the messy bed, for some reason, Lu Daosheng suddenly became stunned, and his mind seemed to be stimulated.

"Do I do something?"

After a long silence, Lu Daosheng suddenly said this.

At this time, Yan Lingyun had already reached the entrance of the village. After walking a few more steps forward, she left the village.

If nothing unexpected happens, you will never meet that guy again.

But at this moment, she was actually a little shocked.

She was shocked that she had disappeared for the first time.

Shocked that he didn't kill that brat.

Shocked myself, I actually stopped now.

She didn't notice that she walked here, her pace was getting slower and slower along the way until now she stopped in place.

Damn, don’t that guy know what responsibility means?

If I don’t chase after me, I will really leave!

In this way, Yan Lingyun stood here from early morning to noon.

The sun shines high.

The scorching sun shines on Yan Lingyun's beautiful face. From time to time, passers-by villagers come forward to ask, but Yan Lingyun is silent.

In response, the villagers just shook their heads and left.

They didn't know what Yan Lingyun wanted to do when she stood here, and they didn't really want to know.

Everyone has their own things to do.

There are very few people like Lu Daosheng who do nothing all day.

Finally, Yan Lingyun couldn't help it.

Patience is limited after all.

She bit her red lips lightly, clenched her fists, and turned her head to walk deep into the village.

Lu Daosheng is in danger.
